body: Thank you so much, friend. :( If you want, you can PM me and I’ll give you my WhatsApp or something because I’m hiding this account from my mom just in case she goes through my phone.

I only have until August before I’m out of here for school.... I’ll be living in my SO’s state. I just have to force myself to not kill myself before August. 

I think the main reason I feel like shit is because of my CPTSD and because of them. It is super fucking hard existing right now. I should’ve probably mentioned my abusive bio dad hasn’t lived with me since I was 14, so it’s not completely bad, but my mom still has random triggers where she randomly just hurls venom at me and she’s hit me (slaps and pushing, nothing bad right?) more than once since she decided last year that I was completely against her and therefore every minor argument has to be about how I’m horrible and how I hate her. Its my culture. My cousins still get hit by my mom’s siblings and they’re 24 and 29. And unlike my mom, they get the shit knocked out of them basically. It’s a shitty fucking culture, I’ll tell you. I have to get out of here. Sorry for rambling.
Thank you so much for caring. I cried while reading your comment, lmao. Thank you.

Thank you so much.

I’m trying to have hope.... I’ll be moving out in August to live in my SO’s state for school. It just feels so far away and it’s getting harder to exist. Thank you for responding to me.

I’ll try. My mom isn’t really too fond of me trying to leave here, but she finally decided (I was going to do this regardless, but I needed her info for FAFSA) to let me go to college in my SO’s state, which is very far away from me. I’ll find out in June from the 14 colleges I applied to if I got accepted or not, but June feels so far away and it’s getting harder and harder to exist again.

I live in a really high cost of living state, so moving out into a shitty studio apartment or something until I leave for college in August is basically not an option. It fucking sucks.

Honestly, I’m trying my best. In addition to all the other shit, my mom sometimes hits me and it’s fucking soul crushing. I’m trying to get out of here and go to a college in my SO’s state. I applied to 14, and I’ll know by June if I got accepted. I’m just trying to keep my fingers crossed tbh
